copyPrompt.user:
## Brand facts
1. [positioning] Halden Oat Co. makes high-protein oat clusters for people who want a breakfast that keeps them full until lunch.
2. [proof_point] Rated 4.7 out of 5 across more than 3,000 reviews.
3. [usp] Baked in small batches with whole rolled oats and no seed oils.

## Brand voice
- Warm, practical and lightly playful

## Persona
Name: The Macro Tracker
Description: Gym-goer hitting a daily protein target who is tired of shakes and bars.
Awareness stage: product_aware
Pains:
- Hungry again an hour after a low-protein breakfast
Desires:
- Protein at breakfast without another shake
Customer verbatims:
- "I want my protein in the morning without choking down another shake."

## Task
Platform: meta
Goal: conversions
Strategic angle (INTERNAL strategy — express it through the copy, never quote or restate it): Lead with the health angle proven by winning ads in this market

How to execute the angle:
- The headline must make ONE concrete claim or paint ONE specific moment that proves the angle, using details from the Brand facts section.
- If the angle involves a measurable benefit and a fact states the number, use the number EXACTLY as the fact states it. If no fact states a number, write the line without any number — NEVER invent one.
- If the angle is emotional (nostalgia, status, relief), the line itself must evoke that feeling through specifics — never announce it ("Experience nostalgia" is a failure).
- BANNED — never write these or structurally similar empty retail phrases: "shop smart", "style meets value", "exclusive deals", "don't miss out", "elevate your", "unleash", "discover the difference", "quality you can trust", "your one-stop shop", "treat yourself", "satisfaction guaranteed", "limited time only", "best-kept secret", "game-changer", "shop the look".

## Rules (non-negotiable — verify every one)
1. Do not claim the product treats or prevents any medical condition.

judgeChecklist.requirement: The copy and image comply with this brand rule: "Do not claim the product treats or prevents any medical condition."

No text, headline, caption, banner band, CTA button, or watermark has been ADDED to the image. Text printed on the product's own packaging or label is expected and allowed. A thin bottom compliance-disclaimer strip is a sanctioned overlay and allowed.

Every element of the image relates to the product, its ingredients, its benefit, or its customer; stylised, conceptual, or editorial compositions are acceptable. There are no unrelated or unmotivated people, devices, screens, venues, or props.

variationPlan.text: Product in a realistic in-use scene: the exact moment a customer uses it, natural light, candid framing. Make the brand fact's number physically tangible — quantity, volume, or scale shown through real objects arranged with the product; never render digits, charts, or text.

Product hero on a clean seamless studio background, soft directional lighting, gentle shadow, label facing camera. Evidence of genuine, repeated use — a well-loved, half-finished product in a real setting where it clearly belongs; no people, stars, ratings, or text.
